sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:179409
Court No. - 70

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 40475 of 2023
Applicant :- Suraj

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Manish Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Sri Pradeep Kumar, learned AGA for the State apprised the Court that on 02.09.2023 notice has been served to the informant of the case.
Despite service of notice, none appeared on behalf of the informant.

2. Heard Sri Manoj Kumar Advocate holding brief of Sri Manish Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Pradeep Kumar, learned AGA for the State-respondent.
3.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
22 of 2023, under Sections 363, 368, 376, 120-B IPC & 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station- Badalpur,
District- Gautam Budh Nagar, during pendency of the trial in the court below.
4. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and according to the FIR, on 22.01.2023 minor daughter of the informant aged about 13 years had gone somewhere from his house.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant was not named in the FIR and when victim of the case was recovered and her statement was recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C. then she stated that she had gone along with the applicant and from her statement recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., it appears that physical relationship was developed between both of them with her consent.

He further submitted that when the statement of the victim was recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. then she also implicated the sister of the applicant and this fact clearly suggests that under the pressure of her parents, she started making allegation against the applicant.
He further submitted that although, victim is about 13 years' old but as she according to her own wish had gone along with the applicant, therefore, applicant be enlarged on bail.

6. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that from the record, it reflects that victim is minor girl aged about 10-13 years and in her both the statements she made allegation of making physical relationship against the applicant, therefore, applicant does not deserve bail.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

8. Considering the fact that victim is hardly 10-13 years' old and she in her both the statements stated that applicant made physical relationship with her, in my view, applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, the instant bail application is rejected.

10. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 KK Patel  Suraj vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93079741/
